scenes.text: THE DOOR OPENED. NOT FROM IN HERE.
scenes.narration: On camera six, the security office door opened at three this morning. From in here, it never moved.

scenes.text: I REMEMBER THE TEA GOING COLD
scenes.narration: I have been trying to remember those eleven minutes. All I remember is the tea going cold.
